# Nick Kitchens Appointed as Global Head of Sales & Business Development at Druid AI

Druid AI names Nick Kitchens Global Head of Sales & Business Development, adding a sales leader with more than 15 years of experience who most recently led global sales and business development at Avaamo.

**By the Hiro News Desk**

October 26, 2026 · 2 min read · Data by [Crustdata](https://crustdata.com/)

[Druid AI](https://hironews.com/companies/druid-ai) · [Avaamo](https://hironews.com/companies/avaamo) · Global Head of Sales & Business Development

![Nick Kitchens, from Avaamo to Druid AI](https://hironews.com/images/moves/nick-kitchens.jpg)

Druid AI has appointed Nick Kitchens as Global Head of Sales & Business Development. Kitchens brings more than 15 years of experience, according to Crustdata people data, and joins from Avaamo, where the remit covered sales and business development worldwide. The move caps a steady climb through sales roles at NiCE, Sirion and Weave.

## Career Highlights

At Avaamo, Kitchens led sales and business development on a global scale, a senior role spanning both disciplines. That post followed a stint as Manager, Sales Development at Sirion from 2024 to 2026, and before that an Account Executive role at Weave.

Much of the foundation was built at NiCE, where Kitchens rose from Senior Sales & Business Developer to Sales Development Manager and went on to work as an Account Executive. During those early NiCE years, a parallel role as Data Analyst at the Polynesian Cultural Center added analytical grounding to a career shaped by sales.

## Why It Matters For Druid AI

Druid AI builds human-centric, agent-based AI for enterprises. Powered by the Druid Conductor, its platform develops and manages intelligent agents that simplify processes and enhance interactions with enterprise-grade security and governance. The company counts over 250 partners and 350 clients worldwide.

Crustdata company data shows Druid AI employs 223 people, up 17.4% over the past 12 months. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, the company has raised $81.6 million, including a $31 million Series C in September 2025 backed by Cipio Partners, Hoxton Ventures, Karma Ventures and Smedvig. Romania is home to 131 employees, with 44 more in the United States and 18 in the United Kingdom.

## What's Next

Kitchens arrives as the company builds out its commercial organisation. The Business Development function now numbers 18 people, up 12.5% over the past year after welcoming 4 new members, while the wider Sales function counts 49. Hiring continues in New York, where Druid AI posted a Business Development Representative listing in August 2026. The appointment puts an experienced sales leader at the front of that growth.

Hiro News tracks leadership moves across go-to-market teams every day. People, company and job data in this story comes from [Crustdata](https://crustdata.com/).

## Questions and Answers

### Who is the new Global Head of Sales & Business Development at Druid AI?

Nick Kitchens has been appointed to the role at Druid AI, starting in October 2026. Kitchens joins from Avaamo, where the remit covered sales and business development worldwide.

### What is Nick Kitchens's background?

Kitchens brings more than 15 years of experience, including roles at Avaamo, Sirion, Weave and NiCE. At NiCE, Kitchens rose from Senior Sales & Business Developer to Sales Development Manager and later worked as an Account Executive.

### What does Druid AI do?

Druid AI provides human-centric, agent-based AI for enterprises through a platform powered by the Druid Conductor, which develops and manages intelligent agents. The company counts over 250 partners and 350 clients worldwide and offers solutions for on-premises, cloud or hybrid environments.
